views.name: predicted_sales_window
views.body_sql:
SELECT date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS date, SUM(oi.price) AS predicted_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
views.description: predicted daily toy sales for the required date range using the specified regression model

views.name: target_moving_averages
views.body_sql: SELECT date, AVG(predicted_sales) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_average_sales FROM predicted_sales_window
views.description: combines predicted sales into a 5-day symmetric moving average and filters to the specific target dates
